instruction: The scrolling in Chrome feels jerky. Can you enable the 'smooth-scrolling' experiment flag to make it smoother?

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling the smooth-scrolling experiment flag. Uses custom evaluator function with subset check to verify.
metadata.verification: Uses custom check_enabled_experiments metric with subset check instead of exact equality.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic is semantically correct and can properly verify the instruction
Getter correctly extracts enabled_labs_experiments from Chrome's Local State file (browser.enabled_labs_experiments)
Metric correctly uses subset check (required_experiments.issubset(actual_experiments)) to verify smooth-scrolling is enabled
This allows other experiments to be enabled simultaneously, which is the correct behavior
Experiment names are properly extracted by splitting on '@' to remove version suffixes
Postconfig correctly restarts Chrome (pkill + relaunch) which is necessary for experiment flags to take effect
The evaluator will return 1.0 if 'smooth-scrolling' is present in enabled experiments, 0.0 otherwise
Coverage is complete: the single requirement (enable smooth-scrolling flag) is fully verified
